name: start_aml_report
label: Start AML report (async)
description: Start generating an AML report asynchronously for a company — returns immediately with a `rapport_id` and status 'pending'. Poll with 'Get AML report' until status is 'done'. Use instead of the synchronous AML score for large/complex ownership structures that may otherwise time out, or to start many screenings in parallel. Requires a signed DPA + per-call confirmation (sent as headers). The manifest rate limit is 30 requests per minute for report submission. The report is stored for 60 months under the Norwegian Anti-Money Laundering Act.

validate.patternErrorMessage: Organisation number must be exactly 9 digits.

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.label: Purpose of screening
parameters.help: Sent as the DPA purpose (X-FR-Purpose header). Used for the audit trail and rate-limiting policy.

parameters.name: dpa_confirmed
parameters.label: I confirm DPA coverage
parameters.help: Confirm that a signed data processing agreement (DPA) with Firmaradar covers this screening. Sent as X-FR-DPA-Confirmed on every call — this is a per-call assertion you are making, not a setting. The call is rejected without it.

communication.//: URL-en er RELATIV mot app-basen, som er hardkodet til https://firmaradar.no i app.json. Den var absolutt og bygget fra {{connection.baseUrl}} — en verdi live-connection-en ikke lenger returnerer (målt 19-08: response.data er null). En rutinemessig all-modul-push ville derfor skrevet en mal som interpolerer ingenting over en fungerende live-kjede. Live står allerede riktig; det var repoet som hadde divergert.

interface.name: rapport_id
interface.label: Job ID — pass this to 'Get AML report'
